programs.title: Coastal Africa
programs.desc: The African intertidal zone is home to a unique universe of plants and creatures. Here, life has adapted to survive in a challenging marine environment - some species are able to live on exposed rocks, while others prefer the shelter of rock pools.

programs.title: Gangs of Lemur Island
programs.desc: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

programs.title: Gangs of Lemur Island
programs.desc: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

programs.title: Stormborn
programs.desc: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

director: Jackie Savery: Series Producer & Director, Nigel Pope: Executive Producer

programs.title: Into the Wild Colombia
programs.desc: The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.

director: Angel Garcia-Rojo, Ben Roy, Allison Bean:Producers

programs.title: Into the Wild Colombia
programs.desc: Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate.

director: Angel Garcia-Rojo, Ben Roy, Allison Bean:Producers

programs.title: Animal Senses
programs.desc: The first sense to evolve in the first animals was chemoreception: being able to detect chemicals in the animal’s environment. This helps animals find prey and mates, and to sense predators from a distance.

programs.title: Turtle Beach
programs.desc: Locals call it the ‘arribada’, or ‘arrival’. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

programs.title: A Wild Year on Earth S1E1 -January-February
programs.desc: In the early months of the year, the Earth’s axial tilt brings the height of summer in some places and the depths of winter in others. See how life struggles to survive under these extreme conditions.

director: Karina Holden: Executive Producer, Daniella Ortega: Series Producer

programs.title: A Wild Year on Earth S1E2 -March-April
programs.desc: Travel around the globe to witness the atmospheric shifts that take place in March, from the wave of cherry blossoms that unfold across Japan to the final raft of green sea turtles that arrive on the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay eggs.

director: Karina Holden: Executive Producer, Daniella Ortega: Series Producer
